description: This source file defines the Order entity class in a Java-based e-commerce application. It maps to the ORDERS database table and contains properties related to customer orders, including status, dates, total amounts, payment and shipping details, related order products, and historical status changes.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order in the e-commerce system, including status, customer info, dates, totals, payment/shipping info, related products, histories, and associated merchant store.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the order.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the order.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Gets the last modification date of the order.

methods.name: setLastModified
methods.description: Sets the last modification date of the order.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Retrieves the purchase date of the order.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the purchase date of the order.

methods.name: getOrderDateFinished
methods.description: Gets the date when the order was completed.

methods.name: setOrderDateFinished
methods.description: Sets the date when the order was completed.

methods.name: getCurrencyValue
methods.description: Returns the exchange rate value associated with the order's currency.

methods.name: setCurrencyValue
methods.description: Sets the exchange rate value for the order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount for the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the order.

methods.name: getIpAddress
methods.description: Fetches the IP address from which the order was placed.

methods.name: setIpAddress
methods.description: Sets the IP address for the order.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the sales channel through which the order was placed.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.description: Sets the sales channel for the order.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Returns the type of the order.

methods.name: setOrderType
methods.description: Sets the order type.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Retrieves the payment method type.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment method type.

methods.name: getPaymentModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the payment module used for the order.

methods.name: setPaymentModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the payment module code.

methods.name: getShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the shipping module code.

methods.name: setShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the shipping module code.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency associated with the order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Associates a currency with the order.

methods.name: getMerchant
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with the order.

methods.name: setMerchant
methods.description: Sets the merchant store for the order.

methods.name: getOrderProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of products included in the order.

methods.name: setOrderProducts
methods.description: Sets the products included in the order.

methods.name: getOrderTotal
methods.description: Returns the order total breakdown.

methods.name: setOrderTotal
methods.description: Sets the total breakdown for the order.

methods.name: getOrderHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the history of status changes for the order.

methods.name: setOrderHistory
methods.description: Sets the order status history.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns delivery details for the order.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets delivery details for the order.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Returns billing information for the order.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets billing information for the order.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves the customer ID associated with the order.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's email address.

methods.name: setCustomerEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's email address.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the locale setting for the order.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the order.
